Name: Mental Tether
Description: You reach into the mind of one creature you can see within range. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw, taking 3d8 psychic damage on a failed save, and their location is made known to you until the spell ends so long as you are both on the same plane of existence. While you have this knowledge, the target can’t become hidden from you, and if they are invisible, they gain no benefit from that condition against you. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage and you are not made privy to their location. If anything causes this effect to break apart due to you unwillingly ending concentration (such as by moving to a different plane, you taking damage that results in a failed concentration check, or dispelling it using magic), the target takes the spell’s damage again.
At Higher Levels:
When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you gain one of the following effects for each slot level above 2nd:
● The damage increases by 1d8.
● You can target one additional creature within range (the spell’s effect ending as described causes it to affect all targets the connection is broken for).
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
